gloss: consultation session; information meeting; advisory session

definitions.gloss: consultation meeting; information session; Q&A event
definitions.explanation: An event where people can come to ask questions and receive advice from experts or representatives. Common in contexts such as schools explaining their programs, companies offering career counseling, or municipalities providing legal or health advice to residents.

notes:
An event where attendees can get individual advice on a specific topic. Literally ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (consultation) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering). Widely advertised by schools, local governments, banks, real estate agencies, and so on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相談会|そうだんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ / ⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧: to hold a consultation session
- {相談会|そうだんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to attend a consultation session
- ⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧{相談会|そうだんかい}: school/university information session
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧{相談会|そうだんかい}: job counseling session
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧{相談会|そうだんかい}: legal consultation session
- {健康|けんこう}{相談会|そうだんかい}: health consultation session

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{説明会|せつめいかい}→説明会：03087_setsumeikai⟧: briefing; information session — focuses on presenters explaining things to attendees, rather than on individual questions
- ⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧: one-on-one meeting/interview — typically a private conversation rather than an event
- ⟦{講演会|こうえんかい}→講演会：15096_kouenkai⟧: lecture event — one speaker presenting to an audience

USAGE:
Unlike ⟦{説明会|せつめいかい}→説明会：03087_setsumeikai⟧, which is typically a group presentation, a {相談会|そうだんかい} emphasizes interactive, individual questions and answers. Attendees can usually speak privately with staff about their specific concerns.
